desc: Parse input: read N, M, S_x, S_y; read N houses; read M moves.
Build `by_x`: dict mapping x -> sorted list of (y, idx); build `by_y`: dict mapping y -> sorted list of (x, idx).
Compute new position `(nx, ny)` based on direction.
If dir in ('L','R'): use `by_y[y]`, find indices `l = bisect_left(lst, (min(x,nx), -inf))`, `r = bisect_right(lst, (max(x,nx), +inf))`.
If dir in ('U','D'): use `by_x[x]`, find indices `l = bisect_left(lst, (min(y,ny), -inf))`, `r = bisect_right(lst, (max(y,ny), +inf))`.
Iterate over `lst[l:r]`; for each `(coord, idx)`, if not `seen[idx]`, set `seen[idx]=True` and `count+=1`.
Use `sys.stdin.read().split()` for fast input; use `bisect` module.
Test with sample inputs to verify correctness.
